The escalation reason states its own clearing condition, a panel adjudication. One arbiter is not that panel, and clearing the row with no record of a panel decision would convert an authority the mission spec reserves to operators into an agent decision — ARIA cannot grant itself authority. A second open question points the same direction: the proposed capability is a banned-phrase adapter, and the ARIA specification's existing-tool delegation matrix (SPEC section 9.6) already assigns banned-phrase checking to the repository gate that owns it, requiring a written delegation record before any second implementation; nothing admissible in this run shows that record exists. Resolution stays blocked and escalation genesis-c9af2037f535eb5d remains open for the panel adjudication it names. No disposition field is emitted: disposition is admissible only with verdict=resolve on a lease_lifecycle escalation, and this is a genesis escalation.\"\n    },\n    \"explanation\": {\n      \"task\": \"Read escalation genesis-c9af2037f535eb5d, decide on the admissible evidence whether it can be cleared, and answer only inside details.adjudication with a verdict from {resolve, refuse, insufficient_evidence} plus the evidence relied on.\",\n      \"why_it_matters\": \"HUMAN_REQUIRED is the kernel's fail-closed stop. verdict=resolve closes that stop and lets the autonomy pipeline move past it, so a resolve that no evidence backs silently rewrites 'a panel must decide' into 'an agent decided' — and the record keeps no trace of the difference.\",\n      \"what_breaks_if_skipped_or_rubber_stamped\": \"An unearned resolve would let agent genesis proceed without the panel the escalation names, and would admit a second banned-phrase implementation beside the gate that already owns that check — two divergent enforcers of the very phrase ban ARIA applies to its own output. The opposite error, withholding a resolve that evidence would have supported, costs one more cycle of queue dwell; that is the cheaper failure, which is why insufficient_evidence is the correct answer under doubt.\",\n      \"downstream_surface\": \"The human-required queue and the governance ledger (this escalation row stays open and is re-presented), the skill-genesis pipeline (the capability gap stays at REQUEST; no agent file is drafted, sandboxed or shadowed), and the nightly autonomy cycle that drains the queue.\",\n      \"evidence_that_would_prove_resolution\": \"A panel adjudication record bound to escalation id genesis-c9af2037f535eb5d, or evidence that the capability gap is no longer live.
